evidence.quote: rollback rehearsals run monthly from now on

observations.why: Directive establishes a recurring safety practice (conservation) and frames rehearsal as necessary for operational readiness (competence).

evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have

observations.why: Aphoristic framing elevates rehearsed readiness to the status of actually possessing the capability — security-through-preparedness and mastery-as-possession.

mints.name: UnrehearsedCapabilityIsNoCapability
mints.title: a capability we have not rehearsed is a capability we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the value move here equating possession of a capability with having rehearsed it — collapsing the gap between having and having verified?
